name: Cairn
look: a sturdy russet-and-cream mountain ram with heavy curled horns ringed in stone-grey bands and a thick, weather-worn coat
temperament: Stubborn, loyal and immovable; it plants itself between her and any danger
scenePlacement: standing on a boulder beside her, horns lowered and steady
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
